name: JetBrains Space API
tagline: HTTP API for JetBrains Space DevOps automation
description: JetBrains Space is an all-in-one collaboration and DevOps platform covering git hosting, CI/CD, issue tracking, packages, and team tools. Its HTTP API lets developers and agents automate work across Space projects—managing repositories, issues, packages, members, and more—via authenticated REST-style endpoints on organization-specific hosts.

auth.details: Permanent tokens or OAuth 2.0 apps; Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN. Tokens created in Space (My Profile → Personal Tokens or app credentials).

use_cases: list Space projects and repositories for an organization
create or update issues in a Space project
trigger or inspect CI/CD automation jobs
fetch team directory profiles and membership
post chat messages or notifications from bots
